title: Verified comparisons for retinal vessel refinement
paper_title: Structural Objectives and Native-Resolution Patches for Direct and Flow-Matching Retinal Vessel Refinement
paper_status: research manuscript draft; no publication DOI assigned
selection: validation only; separate objective30/native15 phase locks

CHASE.uncertainty: Exploratory unadjusted paired percentile intervals on previously examined cohorts. The primary descriptive contrast is raw native-patch Direct minus preserved original Direct in Dice; baseline comparison is mandatory. All other original arms and both v3 objective variants are secondary, as are all blended and structural comparisons. Five fixed fitted-refiner outputs stay together within each resampling unit. CHASE enumerates all 256 ordered resamples of four paired two-eye patient clusters; exhaustive computation does not imply exact confidence coverage. DRIVE and HRF use 50000 paired image draws with seed 20261115; independent patient IDs are unverified. No pixels or training seeds are independently resampled. Seed sample SD is separate. All comparisons condition on one frozen baseline per dataset, the retained OOF maps, trained refiners and fixed split. No pooling, p-values, multiplicity adjustment, equivalence or significance claim is supplied.
